build_robot_base_from_urdf: build a RobotBase instance from a URDF file with configurable mobile or leg base type
reconfigure_robot_joints_and_motors: reconfigure the robot by loading URDF and setting wheel and leg joint motor gains
set_robot_base_position: set the robot base ground position using a 3D vector with configured local offset
control_leg_joint_motors: control leg robot joint motor positions by setting target values for each leg joint
update_robot_base_transformation: update the robot base transformation using rigid state and target rigid state with step filtering
